1. Press WIN+R, enter secpol.msc to open the Local Security Policy.



![Alt Text](https://linux.do/uploads/default/original/4X/e/5/6/e56fe9c7b8dc8ff1419d8a7db68c48ca10fae572.png)



Click on the policy in the network list manager, double-click Mihomo



![Alt Text](https://linux.do/uploads/default/optimized/4X/0/c/6/0c69fe3e156b6c7a55a3d014048c00c2e39a71b6_2_690x495.png)





Click on the network location, select "Special Use", restart Clash, and you can access the internet normally.
